subject: Initial RFI: SOC 2 / SIG artifacts and evidence gating
messages:
From: Lara Benton <lara.benton@cobaltcorp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: procure@cobaltcorp.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: SOC 2 / SIG — initial evidence ask

Rafael,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor due diligence for the Eta project (we're evaluating inference providers), procurement needs a first-pass evidence packet so our security team can start validation. Specifically, can you provide the following by end of next week (2027-09-10):

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF or link to auditor upload)
- ISO 27001 certificate if available
- Completed SIG questionnaire for our intake (we can accept an exported spreadsheet)
- Control-to-evidence mapping for the controls we highlighted in the RFP (Encryption, KMS, IAM, Logging, Data residency)
- List of contacts for a technical walkthrough (who can join a 60-min deep dive)

Also flag any material gaps up-front — e.g., controls that are in progress or out of scope for hosted deployments. If you have an evidence-bundle link or a secure upload location, please send that instead of attaching everything to email.

Regards,
Lara Benton
Security Program Manager | CobaltCorp

--
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lara Benton <lara.benton@cobaltcorp.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC 2 / SIG — initial evidence ask

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick plan and gating so you know what to expect: 

1) What we'll deliver by 2027-09-07 (initial packet):
   - SOC 2 Type II PDF (redacted where needed)
   - Completed SIG export focused on your requested control families
   - Control-evidence index (CSV) mapping your RFP control IDs to artifacts
   - A short notes doc calling out any in-progress items and timelines

2) What may follow after that (within 5 business days):
   - Raw logs / exports (IAM policy export, key rotation logs) where we can safely provide them
   - Auditor contact info if you need to verify the SOC report directly

3) Technical walkthrough:
   - Proposed time: 2027-09-09 14:00 PT (we can move as needed). Attendees: Jasmine Liu (Solutions Architect), Karthik Iyer (Security Lead).

Attachments/status: we'll upload an evidence bundle to a secure Drive link (I will share separate link). For anything that is restricted (e.g., KMS key material), we'll provide attestations and operational logs rather than raw key material.

If that schedule works, we will post the Drive link and a short index file by EOD Tuesday (2027-09-07).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0169

--
From: Lara Benton <lara.benton@cobaltcorp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cobaltcorp.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC 2 / SIG — initial evidence ask

Rafael — that timeline is helpful, thanks. A couple clarifications from our security team so the packet can be reviewed without back-and-forth:

- For encryption controls: we need KMS rotation history (last 12 months) and the policy that forces rotation. If you cannot provide raw exports, the operational log export plus a signed attestation from your security lead is acceptable.
- For IAM: please include an org-wide IAM policy export (roles + attached policies) and a short write-up on your privileged access process for operators.
- For logging: we want retention windows and sample syslog/trace entries (scrubbed) showing TTLs and retention enforcement.
- For data residency: confirm which regions are supported and whether logs/metrics cross regions.
- Contracting: procurement asked for a draft DPA redline and a DocuSign link for our MSSA — can you route that to procurement?

If any of these require a longer lead time, flag which ones and give estimated delivery dates. Our security team prefers to triage the SOC + SIG packet first and only request deeper artifacts later — that's why the control map is important.

Regards,
Lara

--
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lara Benton <lara.benton@cobaltcorp.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procure@cobaltcorp.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SOC 2 / SIG — initial evidence ask

Lara / Procurement team — delivering our initial evidence bundle and a short delivery plan. Please see attachments and the Drive link below. I've annotated items that are redacted or provided as attestations.

Included (initial packet):
- redwood_soc2_type2_2027.pdf (redactions: customer-specific log samples removed; auditor contact included)
- sig_complete_cobalt_20270907.xlsx (SIG export filtered to your control families)
- control_evidence_index.csv (maps your RFP control IDs to artifacts in the Drive)
- redwood_dpa_draft.docx (DPA with proposed redlines; procurement copy)

Items we are providing as attestations / scheduled follow-ups:
- KMS rotation history: attached as kms_key_rotation_export_202708.tar.gz (operational export; sensitive fields removed). Full rotation audit is available to customers under a controlled access process — can provide via a secure APIVault request if you need raw records. Estimated availability: 2027-09-14.
- IAM policy export: attached as part of control_evidence_index.csv (policy summaries). Full JSON exports are available for review in a signed NDA access channel — ETA 2027-09-13.
- Logging samples: we included scrubbed sample traces in the Drive folder (see index).

Drive (secure): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CobaltCorp/RFI-8742/evidence-bundle
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8247
DocuSign MSSA (for procurement): https://app.docusign.com/REDWOOD/MSSA-DEAL-8247

Next steps / asks for CobaltCorp:
- Confirm whether the initial packet is sufficient for triage by 2027-09-10.
- Confirm technical walkthrough slot: 2027-09-09 14:00 PT (J. Liu, K. Iyer, and I will join).
- If you need tighter access to raw exports, state which artifacts and we'll coordinate access via APIVault (requires signed NDA / controlled access).

If procurement wants the DPA redline incorporated into the MSSA routing, please loop your contracting owner and we'll push a DocuSign envelope with the updated DPA.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if anything in the bundle is unclear.

Best regards,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0169
